deprecations.name: lr-retry

replacement.name: lr-retry-request
replacement.usage: addEventListener('lr-retry-request', event => { /* Call preventDefault() to veto the proposed action. */ })

deprecations.rationale: Cancelable proposals use request event names. The historical event remains a veto alias during its compatibility window.
